def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))

    return nil

  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1

  timestamp = nil
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest.fetch(0)
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = self.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest.at(0)
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest.key?(0)
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[-1]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[nil]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{nil}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("CDX lookup error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|

  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1

rescue StandardError => e

def lookup_archive(url)
  log_debug("lookup_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  cdx_url_str = "https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=#{encoded_url}&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&limit=-1&fl=timestamp,original"
  cdx_url = URI.parse(cdx_url_str)
  log_debug("CDX lookup URL: #{cdx_url_str}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(cdx_url.host, cdx_url.port, use_ssl: cdx_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(cdx_url.request_uri))
  }
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    log_debug("CDX lookup failed: #{response.code} #{response.message}")
    return nil
  end
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page...")
  rows = JSON.parse(response.body)
  if rows.length <= 1
    return nil
  end
  latest = rows.last
  timestamp = latest[0]
  archive_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/#{timestamp}/#{url}"
  log_debug("CDX lookup found archived page: #{archive_url}")
  archive_url
rescue StandardError => e
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse

    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })

  }

  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = self.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = nil
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30)
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(nil, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(self.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, self.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl__mutant__: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: nil, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: nil == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout__mutant__: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == nil, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = self.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new({ "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)

  if location && !location.empty?

    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e

  nil

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    req
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

    http.request(req)

    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = self["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

    http.request(req)

    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e

  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = nil
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response.key?("content-location")
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response[nil]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil

    archive_url

    nil
  end

  nil

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response[]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response[""]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if nil && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !false
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && nil
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)

    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end

  nil

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !true
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if false
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !self.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  (archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"; log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}"); archive_url)
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")

  end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    "SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}"
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end

  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil

def submit_archive(url)
  log_debug("submit_archive(#{url})")
  encoded_url = URI.encode_www_form_component(url)
  save_url = URI.parse("https://web.archive.org/save/#{encoded_url}")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(save_url.host, save_url.port, use_ssl: save_url.scheme == "https", open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 30) { |http|
    req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(save_url.request_uri, { "User-Agent" => archive_user_agent })
    http.request(req)
  }
  location = response["content-location"]
  if location && !location.empty?
    archive_url = "https://web.archive.org#{location}"
    log_info("SavePageNow archived #{url} -> #{archive_url}")
    archive_url
  else
    log_debug("Archive submission returned no location for #{url}")
    nil
  end
rescue StandardError => e
  log_debug("Archive submission error for #{url}: #{e.message}")
  nil
end
